verses.pali: “Sattime, bhikkhave, bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā buddhiyā aparihānāya saṁvattanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when the seven awakening factors are developed and cultivated they lead to growth and progress.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta bojjhaṅgā bhāvitā bahulīkatā buddhiyā aparihānāya saṁvattantī”ti.
verses.english: When these seven awakening factors are developed and cultivated they lead to growth and progress.”
